obligations.title: Freeze definitions, toolchain and trust
obligations.implementationDetails: Pin Lean 4.34.1 and all installed toolchain inputs. Audit every project theorem, including private/generated declarations, under --trust=0, warnings as errors and disabled generated injectivity lemmas. Require an empty transitive axiom set; source hashes alone do not prove implementation correspondence.

obligations.title: Extract the selected raw predicate tree
obligations.implementationDetails: Specify Predicate.getBody, Body/NOOP retention, ordered children and occurrence identities. Cover every admitted node constructor; reject unsupported nodes instead of silently treating them as leaves.

obligations.title: Make raw AST labels unambiguous
obligations.implementationDetails: Model labels as a tagged sum and prove the actual Java string encoding preserves the distinctions required by the chosen metric. State explicitly that bound-variable spelling remains significant and source offsets are not label identity.

obligations.title: Verify postorder, leftmost leaves and keyroots
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove contiguous subtree intervals, parent-after-child indices, unique occurrences, leftmost bounds, keyroot coverage and strict dependency ordering. Use Fin-indexed arrays in Lean.

obligations.title: Define unit node-edit semantics
obligations.implementationDetails: Define deletion with ordered child promotion, insertion with adoption of a contiguous child interval, and relabeling. Include root/empty-forest cases and a sentinel whose cost is never counted.

obligations.title: Relate edit scripts to ordered mappings
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove injectivity and preservation/reflection of ancestor and left-to-right order; convert legal mappings to scripts and back with equal cost. Do not assume the desired optimality conclusion in a certificate field.

obligations.title: Prove the forest recurrence optimal
obligations.implementationDetails: Give an independent recursive forest specification. Prove each branch sound and every valid mapping represented; use induction on combined forest size for both upper and lower bounds.

obligations.title: Refine Zhang-Shasha tables to that recurrence
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove nested-loop invariants for forestDistance/treeDistance and prefix-plus-subtree transitions. Establish all cells read are initialized for the intended intervals; conclude the final cell equals the semantic minimum.

obligations.title: Prove termination and bounded arithmetic
obligations.implementationDetails: Refine Nat costs to Java int/long under the node and forest-work budgets. Treat timeout, resource exhaustion and malformed input as explicit failure, never distance zero or a partial pool result.

obligations.title: Verify backtracking and stable tie-breaking
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove backtracking decreases a well-founded measure, follows minimal cells, emits each insert/delete/replace exactly once, and has total cost equal to the distance. Fix the tie priority and original learner coordinate convention.

obligations.title: Verify private trace replay
obligations.implementationDetails: Replay actual node edits including promotion/adoption, not subtree replacement. Prove the reconstructed private labelled tree is the selected target; mutation witnesses must reject omitted edits, duplicate indices and wrong adopted intervals.

obligations.title: Select the nearest complete inclusive pool
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove oracle membership, nonempty validated pool, evaluation of every member, first-minimum tie behavior and selected cost <= every candidate cost. Classification correctness is a separate trusted premise, not global nearest-correct completeness.

obligations.title: Specify the actual Fast Rewrite normalization
obligations.implementationDetails: Give the exact supported normalization relation including alpha, quantifier, temporal, Boolean and relational cases. Prove termination/determinism for this implementation before any semantic preservation theorem. Do not substitute the newer certified quotient metric for Fast Rewrite.

obligations.title: Verify canonical component costs
obligations.implementationDetails: Specify temporal, binding and matrix costs; prove ordered DP and unordered assignment optimal under exactly the implemented constraints. State zero distance as equality under those conventions, not automatic Alloy equivalence.

obligations.title: Verify canonical traces and honest aggregates
obligations.implementationDetails: Verify chosen variable/child alignment, learner paths, unit matrix/binding costs and replay. Keep temporal aggregate evidence distinct from an atomic script or an optimality certificate.

obligations.title: Preserve structural source identity
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove occurrence identity survives only the declared rewrites; merging conflicting origins clears precision. Verify path-to-render span indexing, exact renderer agreement, binder ordering, insertion anchors and exclusion of helper/declaration positions.

obligations.title: Verify UTF-16 ranges and display compaction
obligations.implementationDetails: Specify inclusive Alloy positions and end-exclusive UTF-16 wire offsets. Prove body rebasing, CRLF/tab handling, surrogate boundaries, quote-preserving whitespace compaction and rejection of stale/out-of-body spans.

obligations.title: Verify public projection under explicit disclosure
obligations.implementationDetails: Define permitted disclosure: selected metric/distance, approved replacement operators, learner fragments, pool counts, bounded witness categories. Prove public serialization depends only on that public view, not hidden operands or credential bytes. Full target noninterference would be false because distances intentionally reveal information.

obligations.title: Verify Luna evidence and response boundaries
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove evidence contains all and only supplied operation/instance IDs, metric-specific components and bounded learner data. Verify output shape, ID coverage, stale binding and configured redaction. Model prose remains untrusted; no theorem that unrestricted natural language can never reveal an inferable solution.

obligations.title: Verify bounded behavioral score and categories
obligations.implementationDetails: Specify shared signature identity, model-fact conjunction, four Boolean truth combinations, sampling denominator correction and exact rounding to 0.001. Separate SAT witness checking from exhaustive/UNSAT claims and from unbounded semantic equivalence.

obligations.title: Verify metric-aware browser state transitions
obligations.implementationDetails: Model exercise, draft, revision, metric and behavior token as request identity. Prove switched/aborted/late responses cannot replace another state, caches include the metric, and AST mode never fabricates a canonical correspondence.

obligations.title: Verify delivery and dashboard disclosure
obligations.implementationDetails: Prove public dashboard and source-release artifact allowlists exclude credentials, hidden reference files and the private IIS ZIP. Separately verify the private IIS archive isolates its necessary oracle/correct-pool backend data from wwwroot. Treat GitHub status, IIS ACL enforcement and actual machine execution as external tested/trusted systems.

obligations.title: Bind Lean statements to implementation objects
obligations.implementationDetails: Choose a verified extracted implementation or an independently verified proof-certificate checker. Bind adapter, DP and trace code hashes, Java semantics, wire decoding and actual inputs. Differential tests alone do not establish all-input refinement.

obligations.title: Make the formal closure gate fail closed
obligations.implementationDetails: Register theorem existence, exact statement/type hashes, transitive axiom allowlists, code correspondence, witness checks and two frozen builds. Missing proofs, changed sources, absent mappings or undeclared trust must block; never count OPEN records as proved.
